content: The support vector machine (SVM) was first presented in BIBREF16 and performs the separation between samples of two different classes by projecting them onto a higher dimensionality space. It was first applied in text classification by BIBREF17 and have since been successfully applied in many tasks related to natural language processing BIBREF18 , BIBREF19 .
